h1: Watercolor "WaterColor Me Happy!" 1267 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. **This home sleeps 8 and is allowed 8 amenity access bands.**- Located in the Camp District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Professionally decorated - 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 3 adult bikes- 2 dedicated parking spots - Complete Clean Linen Participant-ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Located in the Camp District of WaterColor, 1267 Western Lake Drive is a fabulous 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home with sleeping accommodations for 8. It's professionally decorated to reflect the classic Old Florida style that will make you feel right at home. It also comes with a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle and bikes to make cruising around 30A and to the beach a breeze! The home is conveniently located near Publix and a few of the many parks, playgrounds, and nature trails that WaterColor is known for! In addition, guests of this home will also have full access to the WaterColor Beach Club. Here guests can enjoy multiple restaurants, chair service, and a multi-level pool that allows everyone in your group to have fun! The home has a recently renovated kitchen, which features stainless steel appliances, custom wooden cabinetry, and sparkling white countertops. There is seating for 3 at the breakfast bar and 6 at the dining table, so everyone has room to enjoy a meal together. The living area also has multiple chairs and sofas surrounding the flat-screen TV and access to the screened porch. The porch located in the back of the house has a cozy bed swing and additional seating to enjoy a morning cup of coffee outside. There is a bedroom on the first floor with a king bed and private bathroom attached with walk in shower. The remaining guest rooms and the laundry room are upstairs and a hallway daybed for extra accommodations. The first has a king bed with a private bathroom, while the other also has a king bed and a bathroom that is shared with the hallway. Enjoy making new memories on 30A with friends and family, and book 1267 Western Lake Drive today!
